phases.purpose: Main and setup original menu traversal
Original Main quit and DLL terminal flush

core_bindings.scope: Prepared exact per-run core allocations, copied bytes, named leave and relocated E8 identities only. No installed-hook, inferred logical tail/original owner, side-effect or scenario closure assertion.

core_caller_review.scope: Independent closed-journal pairing, active-count/newest-return and exact per-run core binding review. Physical callers remain intact. A same-thread/same-original-return-slot/same-cleanup inherited continuation identifies the observed parent/root, not an original CALL edge to the child or semantic owner. Discovered continuation ranges do not fill unknown functions/flows; unresolved indirect/tail callers, writers and scenario/dispatch closure remain pending.

core_physical_caller_review.scope: Exact per-run relocated E8 and named leave identities only; logical tail flow/original owners remain pending.

api_resources.scope: Selected successful original client API borrow intervals only. Failure outputs remain raw; open/overlapping/unobserved origins, external aliases/reference ownership, concurrent use, memory writers and actual destruction remain unresolved. No pixel/caller/scenario/DRAW-01 closure.

api.scope: Closed V2 API diagnostic pairs with reviewed exact layouts and bounded raw buffers. Receiver candidates are byte equality only; failed outputs, external object lifetime, full semantics/graphics/API/writer/scenario closure are not inferred.

api_bindings.scope: Prepared exact per-run allocations/module/physical CALL identities only; no installed-hook success or inferred original/logical/API/COM ownership.

physical_caller_review.scope: Exact prepared per-run PCs/module membership only; original/logical owners and tail flow remain pending.

remaining: All writer/side-effect coverage needs separate review.
Observed indirect/tail callees need exact call-flow classification.
Graphics API, borrowed access, failure/recovery and complete dispatch remain separate obligations.
